'''May 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Seattle, Washington on 6 May 2000. It is known from Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d677">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-seattle-washington-5-6-00d677/ seattle-washington-5-6-00], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 6 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-seattle-washington-5-6-00d677/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 23
